Colored cars show each plant at the same simulation time. Camera and playback interpolation affect only the display; the trajectories come from the recorded simulation. Enable follow view to inspect vehicle motion through a bend.

Measured results

PlantLap time (s)RMS offset (m)Peak offset (m)Peak force ratioBody margin (m)

The force ratio is √(Fx² + Fy²) / Fz with normalized μ = 1. Native MF_SIMPLE, Liniger and the Gao pure-slip adapter do not enforce a friction circle. N/A denotes a force model absent from the comparison. Body margin is checked using 40 perimeter points every 0.02 s.

This compares model families under the same tracking controller. Gao includes only its published pure-slip tire equations; Beal uses declared common parameters and a quasi-static normal-load closure; Sun has no tire-force law. The model variants do not reproduce the theses’ controllers or calibrated experiments. The prescribed speed schedules do not optimize minimum lap time.

Source reference: TUM OCD 94f8fb187fb0ed22bba1d809bd74f66d1ff75af4. Read README.md and RESULTS.md alongside this replay for equations, constraints, validation and provenance.
